definition: NEDCFSAG refers to the KDM6B-related neurodevelopmental disorder cataloged under OMIM #618505 (also known as Stolerman neurodevelopmental syndrome, or NEDSST). The provided sources note that OMIM previously/currently classifies this condition as 'neurodevelopmental disorder with coarse facies and mild distal skeletal abnormalities' (from which the acronym NEDCFSA/NEDCFSAG derives). Although the full expansion of the exact acronym 'NEDCFSAG' is not explicitly spelled out letter-by-letter in the provided text snippets, the sources identify MIM #618505 as the KDM6B-related neurodevelopmental disorder presenting with developmental delay, dysmorphic facial features, and skeletal abnormalities.

source.title: The clinical and molecular spectrum of the KDM6B-related neurodevelopmental disorder
source.quote: OMIM currently classifies this KDM6B-related NDD as “neurodevelopmental disorder with coarse facies and mild distal skeletal abnormalities” (MIM: 618505).
